name: Pio — always next to you
description: A small companion over every app: sees which window you work in, talks and listens, takes the mouse when you hand it over, and passes bigger work to the team.
integration.summary: Pio floats over every app on your computer, sees what you work on, talks, and gives you a hand
integration.example: Pio, what's wrong with this formula?
overlay.workTogetherHint: Pio sees which window you work in
overlay.voiceHint: Talk to Pio; it answers out loud
overlay.controlHint: Pio uses the mouse and keyboard; Esc takes it back
overlay.perm.screen: To see your windows Pio needs Screen Recording. If it is on for Piomio already, turn it off and on again, then restart Piomio.
overlay.perm.accessibility: To use the mouse and keyboard Pio needs Accessibility.
overlay.voice.noMic: The microphone is off for Piomio.
overlay.voice.insecure: Voice works when Piomio opens the hub at localhost or over https.
overlay.voice.noStt: Nothing turns speech into text yet: download the voice.
overlay.noChat: Pio's chat is not ready yet.
